name: Shoe Horse
description: Nail a set of shoes onto a standing horse.

crit_success.message: Four shoes, full set, standing square — speed bonus earned. (The bonus lives on the horse character; craft resolves the consumed shoes and nails here.)

success.message: Shod and sound. (Horse state belongs to the character/NPC layer.)

fail.message: Shod loose — half bonus, refit soon.

crit_fail.message: Thrown shoe — kept, retry. Nothing else lost.
